# scripts/Interaction/Chest.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/Chest.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Lockable lid container. This node sits at the lid hinge; child Lid is an
AnimatableBody3D. Static children form the chest. The closed lid occludes
ordinary frobbables inside; missing Lid leaves animation pending.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `Chest`.
